caption: SPY performance by Cass Freight growth quartile (concurrent, descriptive): Sharpe and annualized return. The gradient is broadly procyclical — Sharpe is lowest in the weakest-freight quartile (Q1 0.34) and highest in the strongest (Q4 1.15), with a mild non-monotonicity between Q2 (1.00) and Q3 (0.88). This matches the procyclical winner (long SPY when freight is not contracting). Descriptive, not a forecast.
